ability_methods.label: Dice roll
ability_methods.help: Roll 4d6 for each ability and keep the 3 highest dice. You may also roll real dice and type your scores.

ability_methods.label: Standard array
ability_methods.help: Place 15, 14, 13, 12, 10 and 8, one value per ability.

ability_methods.label: Point buy
ability_methods.help: Spend 27 points: each score starts at 8 and goes up to 15. A score of 14 costs 7 points, a score of 15 costs 9.

hit_point_methods.label: Hit die average
hit_point_methods.help: At each level after the first, the average of the hit die (5 for a d8), plus the Constitution modifier.

hit_point_methods.label: Hit die roll
hit_point_methods.help: At each level after the first, a roll of the hit die, plus the Constitution modifier (at least 1 point per level). One roll only, kept.

starting_equipment_methods.label: Items or gold, as chosen
starting_equipment_methods.help: For the class and the background, each player takes the items offered or gold pieces.

starting_equipment_methods.label: Items only
starting_equipment_methods.help: Each player takes the items offered by their class and background.

starting_equipment_methods.label: Gold only
starting_equipment_methods.help: Each player gets gold pieces and buys their equipment themselves.

conditions.label: Blinded
conditions.description: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

conditions.label: Charmed
conditions.description: You can't attack the charmer or target them with damaging abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

conditions.label: Deafened
conditions.description: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

conditions.label: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Cumulative, from level 1 to 6. Each level gives −2 to your D20 Tests and reduces your Speed by 5 feet. At level 6, you die. Finishing a Long Rest removes one level.

conditions.label: Frightened
conditions.description: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight. You can't willingly move closer to it.

conditions.label: Grappled
conditions.description: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler. The grappler can drag or carry you, spending extra movement.

conditions.label: Incapacitated
conditions.description: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, and you can't speak. Your Concentration is broken. You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

conditions.label: Invisible
conditions.description: You can't be seen. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage, unless the attacker can see you. You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

conditions.label: Paralyzed
conditions.description: You have the Incapacitated condition, your Speed is 0, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.

conditions.label: Petrified
conditions.description: You are turned to stone, with what you wear and carry. You have the Incapacitated condition, your Speed is 0, attack rolls against you have Advantage, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. You have Resistance to all damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

conditions.label: Poisoned
conditions.description: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.label: Prone
conditions.description: You can only crawl, or spend half your Speed to stand up. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls against you have Advantage from within 5 feet, Disadvantage from farther away.

conditions.label: Restrained
conditions.description: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.label: Stunned
conditions.description: You have the Incapacitated condition and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

conditions.label: Unconscious
conditions.description: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop what you're holding. Your Speed is 0, you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws, attack rolls against you have Advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit. You're unaware of your surroundings.

modes.label: Advantage
modes.help: Roll two dice and keep the higher.

modes.label: Disadvantage
modes.help: Roll two dice and keep the lower.

death_saves.label: Death saving throws
death_saves.help: At 0 HP, a d20 each turn: 10 or more, a success; less, a failure. A 1 counts as two failures, a 20 gives back 1 HP. Three successes: stable; three failures: dead. A hit taken at 0 HP counts as a failure.

fighting_styles.label: Archery
fighting_styles.help: +2 to attack rolls with a ranged weapon.

fighting_styles.label: Defense
fighting_styles.help: +1 to Armor Class while you wear light, medium or heavy armor.

fighting_styles.label: Great Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles.help: When you roll damage for a melee weapon held with two hands (Two-Handed or Versatile), a 1 or 2 on a die counts as a 3.

fighting_styles.label: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles.help: The extra attack of a Light weapon adds your ability modifier to its damage.

fighting_styles.label: Blessed Warrior
fighting_styles.help: Instead of a style: two Cleric cantrips, cast with Charisma (Guidance and Sacred Flame are recommended).

fighting_styles.label: Druidic Warrior
fighting_styles.help: Instead of a style: two Druid cantrips, cast with Wisdom (Guidance and Starry Wisp are recommended).

spell_slots.label: Spell slots
spell_slots.help: A spell of level 1 or higher spends one of its level or higher. All regained after a long rest.

spell_groups.label: Cantrips
spell_groups.help: Cast at will, without a spell slot.

spell_groups.label: Prepared spells
spell_groups.help: Cast with your spell slots, up to the highest level you can cast.

descriptions.Barbarian: A warrior driven by primal rage, who shrugs off blows like no one else.
descriptions.Bard: A performer whose music and words weave magic to support allies.
descriptions.Cleric: A servant of a deity who heals, protects and strikes with divine magic.
descriptions.Druid: A guardian of nature who draws magic from it and can take the shape of animals.
descriptions.Sorcerer: A spellcaster with innate magic, bent to their will.
descriptions.Fighter: A master of every weapon and armour, sturdy and versatile in battle.
descriptions.Wizard: A scholar who learns spells from a spellbook, with a wide range of powers.
descriptions.Monk: A fast, disciplined unarmed fighter who channels inner energy.
descriptions.Warlock: A spellcaster bound by a pact to a mysterious power.
descriptions.Paladin: A holy warrior bound by an oath, combining weapons, healing and divine magic.
descriptions.Ranger: A wilderness scout, tracker and hunter, helped by a little magic.
descriptions.Rogue: A specialist in stealth and precise strikes, skilled at many things.

spellcasting.slots_help: All of the same level, the highest you can cast. Regained after a short or long rest.

descriptions.Path of the Berserker: An unbridled rage that hits harder with every reckless attack.
descriptions.College of Lore: A scholar who gathers knowledge and unsettles foes with a few cutting words.
descriptions.Life Domain: A healer who draws on the energy of life to cure and protect.
descriptions.Circle of the Land: A keeper bound to the wild lands, whose magic changes with the land chosen each day.
descriptions.Champion: A warrior who seeks physical excellence and lands critical hits more often.
descriptions.Warrior of the Open Hand: A master of unarmed combat, who knocks down and pushes back opponents.
descriptions.Oath of Devotion: A knight true to the ideals of justice, honour and the protection of the innocent.
descriptions.Hunter: A tracker who protects nature and people by knowing the weaknesses of the prey.
descriptions.Thief: A nimble adventurer with quick hands, who climbs anywhere in search of treasure.
descriptions.Draconic Sorcery: Magic inherited from dragons, which covers the body in scales and makes it tougher.
descriptions.Fiend Patron: A pact with an infernal power, which grants strength with every foe struck down.
descriptions.Evoker: A master of evocation spells, who shapes fire, lightning and cold without hurting allies.

descriptions.Acolyte: A youth in the service of a temple: rites, prayers and gods hold no secrets.
descriptions.Criminal: A life in the underworld: sneaking, stealing, picking locks.
descriptions.Sage: Years of study: solid knowledge and a few spells learnt from books.
descriptions.Soldier: Military training: fighting, holding the line and standing out.

descriptions.Dragonborn: Descended from dragons, dragonborn have an elemental breath and scaly skin.
descriptions.Elf: Graceful and long-lived, elves see in the dark and meditate instead of sleeping.
descriptions.Gnome: Small, curious and clever, gnomes have a subtle magic.
descriptions.Goliath: Tall and powerful, heirs to giants, goliaths can grow larger for a while.
descriptions.Halfling: Small, nimble and lucky, halflings slip in anywhere.
descriptions.Human: Adaptable and ambitious, humans learn fast and succeed at anything.
descriptions.Dwarf: Sturdy and tenacious, dwarves resist poison and see far in the dark.
descriptions.Orc: Strong and enduring, orcs refuse to fall and see in the dark.
descriptions.Tiefling: Marked by a fiendish heritage, tieflings wield magic from birth.

descriptions.Black Dragon (acid): A breath of acid and resistance to acid damage.
descriptions.Blue Dragon (lightning): A breath of lightning and resistance to lightning damage.
descriptions.Brass Dragon (fire): A breath of fire and resistance to fire damage.
descriptions.Bronze Dragon (lightning): A breath of lightning and resistance to lightning damage.
descriptions.Copper Dragon (acid): A breath of acid and resistance to acid damage.
descriptions.Gold Dragon (fire): A breath of fire and resistance to fire damage.
descriptions.Green Dragon (poison): A breath of poison and resistance to poison damage.
descriptions.Red Dragon (fire): A breath of fire and resistance to fire damage.
descriptions.Silver Dragon (cold): A breath of cold and resistance to cold damage.
descriptions.White Dragon (cold): A breath of cold and resistance to cold damage.
descriptions.Drow: Darkvision of 120 feet. The Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire at level 3 and Darkness at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.
descriptions.High Elf: The Prestidigitation cantrip (changeable after a long rest); Detect Magic at level 3 and Misty Step at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.
descriptions.Wood Elf: A speed of 35 feet. The Druidcraft cantrip; Longstrider at level 3 and Pass without Trace at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.
descriptions.Forest Gnome: The Minor Illusion cantrip; Speak with Animals always prepared, cast without a slot as many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Rock Gnome: The Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; you can build small clockwork devices (tinker).
descriptions.Cloud Giant: Cloud's Jaunt: as a bonus action, you teleport up to 30 feet. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Fire Giant: Fire's Burn: when you hit, +1d10 fire damage. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Frost Giant: Frost's Chill: when you hit, +1d6 cold damage and the target's speed drops by 10 feet. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Hill Giant: Hill's Tumble: a Large or smaller creature you hit has the Prone condition. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Stone Giant: Stone's Endurance: as a reaction, you reduce damage by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Storm Giant: Storm's Thunder: as a reaction, 1d8 thunder damage to the creature that hurt you within 60 feet. As many times as your proficiency bonus per long rest.
descriptions.Abyssal: Resistance to poison. The Poison Spray cantrip; Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.
descriptions.Chthonic: Resistance to necrotic damage. The Chill Touch cantrip; False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.
descriptions.Infernal: Resistance to fire. The Fire Bolt cantrip; Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5, each once per long rest without a slot.

fields.label: Languages
fields.help: You speak Common, and two languages of your choice.

fields.label: Background bonus
fields.help: Spread +2 and +1, or +1 to each.

fields.label: Hit points
fields.help: At level 1: the highest roll of the hit die of the class, plus the Constitution modifier. Then, at each level, the average of the die plus the Constitution modifier.

fields.label: Armor class
fields.help: The armor and the shield equipped, plus Dexterity as far as the armor allows; without armor: 10 + Dexterity (barbarian: + Constitution; monk: + Wisdom). Then the AC bonus given by the game master.

fields.label: AC bonus
fields.help: Given by the game master in play (a spell, a magic item): it is added to the armor class.

fields.label: Initiative
fields.help: The Dexterity modifier.

fields.label: Hit dice
fields.help: One die per level, by class. Spend them during a short rest to regain hit points (the die, plus the Constitution modifier).

fields.label: Proficiency bonus
fields.help: Computed from the level: +2 at levels 1 to 4, +3 at levels 5 to 8, +4 at levels 9 to 12, +5 at levels 13 to 16, +6 at levels 17 to 20.

fields.label: Spell save DC
fields.help: 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the spellcasting ability of your class.

fields.label: Spell attack bonus
fields.help: Proficiency bonus + the modifier of the spellcasting ability of your class.

fields.label: Strength saving throw
fields.help: Your class ticks those it is proficient in, and you can change them: the ability bonus and the proficiency bonus add up on their own.

fields.label: Acrobatics
fields.help: Tick the skills you are proficient in: the ability bonus and the proficiency bonus add up on their own.

fields.label: Features
fields.help: Class and species features, feats: write them down freely.

fields.label: Challenge rating
fields.help: How hard the creature is: a party of four characters of this level beats it with some effort.

fields.label: Other speeds
fields.help: Fly, swim, climb, burrow: "Fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.".

fields.label: Attacks
fields.help: One line per attack: the bonus to hit is added to the d20, the damage is rolled on a hit.

fields.label: Other actions
fields.help: The actions that are not a plain attack: multiattack, breath, and the whole effect of an attack that does more than damage.

fields.label: Training needed
fields.help: A class with this training adds its proficiency bonus to the attacks of this weapon.

fields.label: Base AC
fields.help: The AC of the armor worn, before Dexterity.

fields.label: Dexterity added at most
fields.help: Empty: all of the Dexterity is added (light armor). 2 for medium armor, 0 for heavy armor.

fields.label: AC bonus
fields.help: Added to the AC while it is equipped (a shield: 2).

fields.label: Damage dice
fields.help: For example 1d8: the modifier of the ability of the attack is added to it.

fields.label: Two-handed dice
fields.help: For a versatile weapon, for example 1d10: a second attack, with two hands, while no shield is equipped.

fields.label: Kind of weapon
fields.help: The kind the trainings of the classes and the weapon masteries name.

fields.label: Mastery property

descriptions.cleave: If you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can make a melee attack with this weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first and within your reach; on a hit it takes the weapon's damage, without your ability modifier unless it is negative. Once per turn.
descriptions.graze: If your attack with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal it damage equal to the ability modifier of the attack, of the weapon's type.
descriptions.nick: The extra attack of the Light property can be made as part of the Attack action instead of a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
descriptions.push: If you hit a creature that is Large or smaller, you can push it up to 10 feet straight away from you.
descriptions.sap: If you hit a creature, it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
descriptions.slow: If you hit a creature and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn (no more than 10 feet in all).
descriptions.topple: If you hit a creature, you can force it to succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the modifier of the attack + your proficiency bonus) or have the Prone condition.
descriptions.vex: If you hit a creature and deal damage to it, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.

fields.help: Usable by a character with the mastery of this kind of weapon (weapon masteries).

fields.label: Finesse
fields.help: The attack uses the better of Strength and Dexterity.

fields.label: Ranged
fields.help: The attack uses Dexterity instead of Strength.

preset_items.name: Potion of healing
preset_items.description: A red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

preset_items.name: Shortbow
preset_items.description: A light bow, handy on horseback or on foot.

preset_items.name: Leather armor
preset_items.description: A breastplate and shoulder guards of boiled leather.

preset_items.name: Rope
preset_items.description: You tie a knot with it on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

preset_items.name: Torch
preset_items.description: Sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius, and dim light for 20 more feet, for one hour.
